issue.body: Adding new condition to the rule 'no-constant-condition' as discussed in #5228 . More test cases can be added as part of #5693 .

body: So you're saying this should flag the `false` because it short circuits? If so, I agree.

I'm wondering if this should be a new rule maybe? `no-constant-condition` flags constant conditions on if statements and other clear Boolean-context syntax locations; something like `false && foo` could also be flagged on an AssignmentExpression or VariableDeclarator as well.

But then the question would become, how to make sure `no-constant-condition` also catches it...
@platinumazure sorry, I can't quite follow your rationale for a new rule. The example code in the original description is a constant condition that we are missing.
@nzakas Yes , after fixing #5228 I will work on this .
